transcript: Speaker A: ಮೇಡಂ, ಈ ರೂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ. [Madam, there is heavy traffic on this route.] Speaker B: There is heavy traffic on this route. Speaker A: ನಾನು ಬೇರೆ ರೂಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಾ? [Shall I take another route?] Speaker B: Shall I take another route? Speaker A: ನಾವು ಹತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ತಲುಪ್ತೀವಿ. [We will reach in 10 minutes.] Speaker B: We will reach in 10 minutes. [Whether driving a cab or talking to a customer, practice English speaking for just 15 minutes daily with MySivi app. You speak in Kannada, MySivi teaches you how to say it in English. You can start from just 1 rupee! Click the install button below today, install MySivi app, and start speaking English with confidence.] Speaker C: Click on install now and download MySivi app.

summary: An animated skit features a cab driver speaking Kannada to a robot passenger, who translates his sentences into English. The robot then promotes the MySivi app, explaining that users can practice English by speaking in Kannada and receiving translations. The ad highlights a low starting price of 1 rupee and prompts viewers to install the app.
